chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar, from al-Harith ibn al-Mughira, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would seek forgiveness of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, seventy times every day, and repent to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, seventy times. I said, 'Was he saying: I seek forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him?' He said, 'He was saying: I seek forgiveness of Allah, I seek forgiveness of Allah, seventy times, and he was saying: And I repent to Allah, and I repent to Allah, seventy times.'
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet Muhammad seek forgiveness and repent daily according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the Prophet’s consistent practice of seeking forgiveness and repenting seventy times daily, illustrating the concept of *istighfar* even for the sinless (*ma'sum*) as a means of spiritual elevation and gratitude. This narration underscores the Prophetic model of humility, reinforcing the Shia understanding that divine perfection does not preclude the need for continuous spiritual refinement and connection with the Divine. The specific phrasing emphasizes the rhythmic and disciplined nature of this devotion, serving as a practical guide for believers to emulate in their daily worship.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, from Al Haris Bin Al Mugheira, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was seeking Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic (on behalf of his<sup>saww</sup> nation) seventy times during every day, and he<sup>saww</sup> turned to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic seventy times (every day)’. I said, ‘Was he<sup>saww</sup> saying: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and I<sup>saww</sup> repent to Him<sup>azwj</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He<sup>saww</sup> was saying: 
‘I<sup>saww</sup> seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, I<sup>saww</sup> seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, seventy times, and he<sup>saww</sup> was saying, ‘And I<sup>saww</sup> turn to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, I<sup>saww</sup> turn to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, seventy times’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar from al-Harith ibn al-Mughirah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah would plea for protection seventy times everyday and turn to Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, seventy times everyday.’ I (the narrator) then asked, ‘Would he say, I plea for protection (forgiveness) from Allah and turn to Him?’ The Imam said, ‘He would say, “I plea for protection (forgiveness) from Allah, I plea for protection from Allah,” seventy times. And would say, ‘I return to Allah, I return to Allah,’ seventy times.’”
